V0.2.12.description:
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where you could not get the mysterious key check from Gurd if you possessed the mysterious key.(again ¯\_(ツ)_/¯)
- Fixed an issue where you could not get the blade of skill check if you possessed the blade of skill.
- Fixed an issue where many of the cards in the Cathedral Card Shop were not randomized when randomize shops was enabled.
- Fixed some of the descriptions for the new randomization options in the yaml
- Previously when enemysanity was enabled, enemies that already had checks associated with them would not trigger enemysanity checks; they now do. 
- In addition to the above, added 8 new enemysanity checks that were previously missed.
- The vanilla ways to get the God of Destruction and Birdman cards are now disabled, and gives checks instead.
- Fixed a minor issue with the location "Enemysanity - TriBlaster"
- Fixed an issue where enemysanity/levels as items would result in a mismatch in the item/location count.
